en-US.title: Dipp - Price Tracker
en-US.subtitle: Track prices. Get alerts.
en-US.description:
Dipp is the simplest way to never overpay for something you want.

Paste any product URL from your favourite online stores, and Dipp tracks the price for you — automatically, in the background. When the price drops, you get an instant notification.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Copy a product URL from any supported store
2. Paste it into Dipp — we fetch the product name, image, and current price instantly
3. Dipp checks the price regularly and notifies you the moment it drops

WHAT YOU GET

• Real-time price monitoring — Dipp checks prices automatically so you don't have to
• Instant push notifications — get alerted the moment a price drops below what you first saw
• Full price history — see how a product's price has changed over time with a clear chart
• Clean, distraction-free interface — no ads, no noise, just your tracked products
• Dark mode — easy on the eyes, any time of day

PERFECT FOR

• Waiting for a sale before buying something expensive
• Tracking prices on gifts you want to buy
• Making sure you're getting the best deal before checkout

Dipp is free to use. No subscriptions, no hidden fees.
en-US.releaseNotes: Initial release of Dipp — track product prices and get notified when they drop.
en-US.promoText: Never overpay again. Track any price, get alerted instantly.
